anchor: v1::Leila Haddad, order ORD-20602. The 65L backpack came with a ripped hip belt, clearly from shipping. Refund please.

result.text: I'm sorry your Expedition 65L backpack arrived with a ripped hip belt. Because the order is $260, our policy requires a team member to review shipping damage claims of $200 or more, so I've passed your case to them under ticket ESC-4102. You should hear back within one business day about your refund.

input.summary: Customer Leila Haddad reports the Expedition 65L backpack (order ORD-20602, $260, delivered 2026-09-27) arrived with a ripped hip belt from shipping damage. She is requesting a refund.
